title: Rank Networks
shortDescription: Rank Networks is a powerful tool designed to tackle the complexities of network ranking and provider selection, especially within managed care environments.
body:
**Rank Networks** is a powerful tool designed to tackle the complexities of network ranking and provider selection, especially within managed care environments. It enables users to generate prioritized lists of key providers—such as physicians, hospitals, and medical groups—for use by brokers, consultants, and key decision—makers. ## Key Features: * **Provider-Based Network Ranking:** Ranks networks based on the number of providers within each network and helps you identify the most suitable options. * **Drug Inclusion Capabilities:** Supports network rankings that incorporate drug availability, allowing brokers to evaluate carriers based on formulary choices and share relevant insights with employees. This is an add-on feature and is optional. * **Scalable for All Group Sizes:** Built to serve both small and large employer groups, offering a practical alternative to disruption analysis for smaller organizations that may lack access to advanced analytics. ## Accessing Rank Networks **Rank Networks** can be accessed from the left-hand sidebar navigation panel by clicking on **Sales Tools** or **Broker Tools** and then selecting the **Rank Networks** option.

Creating a Ranking

 The landing page for **Rank Networks** contains two fields, **Client** and **Name**. **Client** – Indicates the client’s name for which you want to create a Ranking. **Name** – Indicates the name of the Ranking.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/creating-new-ranking.png)
1. Type the client's name into the **Client** text field. A list of existing clients associated with the project will appear as you type. * To select an existing client, simply choose the name from the dropdown list. * To create a new client, press the **Enter** key after typing the name. This allows you to quickly add or select clients. 2. In the **Name** text field, enter the desired name for your Ranking. 3. Click the **Save** button to store the Ranking. ### Rank Networks Page The Rank Networks page displays a pop-up message indicating that the Network Ranking is saved and the page displays the following options: * Search for the providers or facilities in the selected state that are important to add to the list. * Review the rankings below to see which networks have the most participating providers. * A button to create a new ranking (Create New Ranking). * Edit the client’s name or ranking name already created by clicking on Edit button. * Delete the created Ranking by clicking on Delete button. * Share the Ranking results.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/screen-after-ranking-is-created.png)
### Searching and Adding Providers or Facilities: 1. Enter the name of a provider or facility in the search field. Click on the Find Providers button. **Note:** Selecting a state is optional. However, choosing a specific state can help narrow down your results for more targeted search outcomes. The list of providers that match the characters entered in the search field will appear on the right side of the screen.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/searching-providers.png)
2. Click on the **+** sign to add providers whose ranking is to be compared. Once added, a confirmation pop-up message will appear, and the **+** icon will change to a red x, indicating the provider has been selected for comparison.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/adding-provider.png)
**Removing a Provider from Ranking Comparison:** To exclude a provider from the ranking comparison, click the red x icon (as shown in the figure above). Once a provider is selected or removed, the ranking results will update to show the comparison. You can see the ranking results under the search and provider list.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/ranking-results.png)
Additional providers can be added to compare their rankings. An example of when more than one provider is added to the ranking comparison list is shown below:
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/ranking-results-for-more-than-one-provider.png)

Understanding Ranking Results Criteria

 The ranking results are displayed in 4 tabs. * Best Networks * Ranking Details * Selected Providers * Excluded Providers ### Best Networks Tab This default tab displays a list of networks derived from the project data. The percentages indicate the proportion of selected providers included in each network. Please refer to the screenshot above for more details. ### Ranking Details Tab This tab lists the Networks with the decreasing order of Ranking for the Physicians, Hospital, Groups, Not in Network and Provider Match %.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/ranking-details-tab.png)
The Physicians, Hospitals and Groups columns compare the number of each to the total number of Providers available in the Project Network. For example, consider PrimeHealth PPO. 3/4 value in Physicians column indicates that 3 out of 4 physicians are present in PrimeHealth PPO and 1 physician is not in network. The 3/4 value corresponds to 75%. ### Selected Providers Tab This tab lists the names of Providers added, their Specialty Groups, Last Added by (name of the person who added the provider in the ranking comparison), Last Added (date) and Times Added (number of times the specific provider was added).
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/selected-providers-tab.png)
### Excluded Networks Tab This tab lists the names of networks which were excluded from Ranking.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/excluded-networks-tab.png)
Networks can be excluded by clicking on the ***settings*** link which navigates you to Home>Settings>Network Ranking tab.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/default-network-exclusions.png)
Click on **+ Add Network Exclusion** button.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/excluded-networks-through-settings.png)
Type the first few characters of the network you want to exclude or click on the dropdown of the project field.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/adding-exclusive-networks-in-settings.png)
After selecting the project from the list, Networks field displays.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/add-network-exclusion-through-settings.png)
Select the network you want to exclude. Click on **Add Network Exclusion** button. A success message gets displayed.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/msg-while-adding-excluded-network-from-settings.png)
The selected network is added to the excluded networks list.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/added-to-excluded-network.png)

Sharing Ranking Results

 Clicking on the **Share** button opens a pop-up box with the link to the ranking results page in the text box and a **Share via Email** button. The link can be copied and pasted as needed. Or click on the **Share via Email** button to automatically generate an email with a subject line and content. Simply add recipients.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/share-button.png)
Alternatively, click on the dropdown arrow of the **Share** button to select other methods to share the ranking results.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/share-dropdown.png)
**Share Results:** Clicking on **Share Results** is the same as clicking the **Share** button directly. This is the default option. **Send Survey:** Clicking on **Send Survey** opens a pop-up box with a link to the survey and a **Share via Email** button. The link can be copied and pasted as needed. Clicking the Share via Email button generates an email with a subject line and content. Simply add recipients.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/share-sendsurvey.png)
The Employee Survey can be used to send participants a link where they will be able to add providers, facilities, drugs (if it's enabled) to the rank network analysis. These will be in addition to any existing selections that were made in the original analysis. The participant providing this information is anonymous.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/share-employeesurvey.png)
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/emailforemployeesurvey.png)
**Export as PDF:** Clicking on **Export as PDF** initiates the export process to create a PDF of the Ranking Results.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/share-export-pdf.png)
A message is displayed stating that the export was initiated. When the results are ready, a popup message with **Download results** link is displayed and an email with a link to download the PDF is sent.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/export-as-pdf-message.png)
The downloaded PDF contains ranking results related to Best Networks, Ranking Details and Selected Providers. **Export Selected Providers:** Clicking on **Export Selected Providers** initiates the export process.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/export-selected-providers.png)
A message is displayed stating that the export was initiated. When the results are ready, a popup message with **Download results** link is displayed and you can download the .csv file. An email with a link to download the .csv file is sent.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/export-provider-details-message.png)
Here is an example for the downloaded .csv file.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/export-selected-providers-csv-file.png)
